description: Source code implementing a TypeConverter interface for Kubernetes objects, including functions for converting between runtime objects and typed values, handling schemas, and parsing GroupVersionKind extensions.

classes.name: typeConverter
classes.description: Implementation of the TypeConverter interface, holding a parser map for converting runtime objects to typed values.

classes.name: deducedTypeConverter
classes.description: A TypeConverter for CRDs without schemas, treating all fields as atomic.

methods.name: ObjectToTyped
methods.description: Converts a runtime.Object to a typed.TypedValue, using schema if available.

methods.name: TypedToObject
methods.description: Converts a typed.TypedValue back to a runtime.Object.

methods.name: valueToObject
methods.description: Converts a value.Value to a runtime.Object, assuming unstructured content.

methods.name: indexModels
methods.description: Indexes schemas by their GroupVersionKind, parsing extensions for GVK info.

methods.name: parseGroupVersionKind
methods.description: Extracts a list of GroupVersionKind from schema extensions.
